noun_definition: Pressing right arrow key refers to the action of using the right arrow key on the keyboard to navigate the cursor one character to the right in the compose box of a chat interface.
Mentioning refers to the action of including a user identifier preceded by an `@` symbol in a message within the chat composer.
Cursor refers to the visual indicator in the compose box that shows the current position for text input and can be moved using the arrow keys.
compose box refers to the text input area in a chat interface where users can type messages, including mentions of other users.
